[[File:Underwater mine.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An underwater mine in the depths of Manaan.]]
'''Underwater mines''' were a type of [[Mine/Legends|mine]] designed to destroy underwater targets.<ref name="TOR:Fortification">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Fortification|Manaan}}</ref>

During the [[Third Galactic War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Submersible minelayer droid|deployed]] underwater mines to protect its underwater [[Imperial Kolto Mining Facility|kolto mining facility]] from [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan|invasion]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:Fortification"/> In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the criminal [[Swagg]] deployed underwater mines in [[Lake Umberbool]], on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], to destroy the arena of the [[Festival of Warriors]]. However, the plot was thwarted by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Fassa (Gungan)|Fassa]].
<ref name="FoW">''[[Episode I Adventures 10: Festival of Warriors]]''</ref>
